items.html: The thing is that in this manner it has been explained that the lights of the Ozen expanded to Shibbolet HaZakan, and the lights of Hotem-Peh pass through there, as well. Hence, when the light of the Einayim of AK is extended through there, it must mix with them and take their light. Indeed, they are ten dots: The first three among them take light from what is extended from the looking of the Ayin in the AHP from their place to the place where they connect to the Shibbolet HaZakan. They receive them only in Shibbolet HaZakan because that is where they begin, and not from what is in Shibbolet HaZakan and above. However, the seven lower Nekudot take only what is extended from the looking in the lights of the Hotem and Peh from Shibbolet HaZakan downward. It is known that the Hotem reaches the Chazeh, and the Peh to the Tabur, and not from Shibbolet HaZakan upward.
